## Description

Extends two-asset cointegration to 3-asset linear combinations ($A - lpha B - eta C$), exploiting Johansen test vector residuals for triangular mean-reversion trades.

## Where it may fit

Highly correlated sector trios (e.g., Chevron, ExxonMobil, ConocoPhillips), structural equity market shifts.

## Vehicles

Quantitative equity market-neutral funds, statistical arbitrage hedge funds.

## Required data

Daily and intraday adjusted close prices, sector membership, corporate event adjustments.

## Caveats

Structural shifts in company underlying fundamentals can break cointegration, triggering permanent divergence losses if untracked.
